cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.

mechanism: A appoints a lantern keeper and accepts the physical lantern back while binding B through the badge to appoint a successor.
confusable: Unlike merely delegating holding, the official identity creates a recruitment and handover obligation even without possession of the object.
comparison: A title with successor duty differs from a patron ribbon requiring repeated applause.
seedUse: D175-a temporary shoe favor, badge and qualified successor; S02-a takes immediate carrying while preserving official duty.
